I found nothing in this draft that needs changing.

- **"We started Pebblebrook in Bristol in 2019"** matches the allowed claim "Founded in Bristol in 2019" (Companies House).
- **"Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable"** is the exact allowed wording, backed by the supplier certificate (EN 13432).
- **"here's how we checked"** is a lead-in to the rest of the post. Make sure the full post only describes checks that really happened, such as the EN 13432 certificate. It must not add claims beyond section 2, like "eco-friendly" or "zero waste".
- **"because we couldn't find tea bags without plastic in them"** is the founding motive. It isn't a stat, a superlative or a green claim, so it is fine as brand storytelling. Sam may want to confirm it's an accurate account of the origin.
- **Voice:** the tone is warm and plain, uses UK spelling, and contains none of the banned words.
- **Approval:** the policy requires Sam to approve everything public, so this still needs his sign-off.
